objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A solid, perfectly square 32×32 pixel hard stone wall tile for a whimsical dark fairy-tale goblin colony simulator. The entire square is completely filled with dense, durable stone in deep slate-grey, cool blue-grey, charcoal and muted steel-grey tones. Large tightly packed angular rock formations, thick fractured planes, narrow dark crevices and heavy mineral density create the appearance of a tough, difficult-to-mine stone wall. The texture is more compact, solid and imposing than ordinary stone, with fewer crumbly gaps and a more weighty, stubborn feel. Cute fantasy pixel art, fixed three-quarter JRPG game aesthetic, crisp pixel placement, strong dark outlines around major stone masses and fractures, limited harmonious colour palette, subtle upper-left lighting and restrained pixel shading. Seamlessly repeating texture on all four edges, with no visible tile boundaries, outer borders or frames. Perfectly square, fully opaque, edge-to-edge hard stone wall texture. No transparency, no empty corners, no isolated boulders, no floor, no vegetation, no characters, no text.
